stem.text: An aeroplane is moving at a constant speed in a straight line at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal.

stem.alt: Aeroplane in straight-line flight at an angle θ to the horizontal, with force arrows labelled T, L, W and R.

stem.text: Which two equations must be correct?
